paragraphs: Transoft Solutions makes software for the people who plan, design and operate transportation systems. Its work spans aviation, civil infrastructure, transportation and operational professionals. On the aviation side that means specialized software to plan, analyze and optimize airport and airspace operations.

The company started in 1991, when co-founder Milton Carrasco developed a vehicle tracking program called AutoTURN. That product grew out of his master's thesis on computerized vehicle-turning simulation. The range has widened since through in-house development and strategic acquisitions. One executive is credited with merging AeroTURN and PathPlanner into AviPLAN.

The company reports more than 100,000 customers in over 150 countries. Clients are described as government agencies at the federal, state, county and municipal levels, along with major international airports and engineering and architectural design firms. Headquarters are in British Columbia, Canada, with further offices in the United States, Australia, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, Belgium, Germany, France, Sweden, Spain, India and China.

quote.text: Transoft Solutions develops advanced and highly specialized software solutions for aviation, civil infrastructure, transportation and operational professionals.
